io.github.sefiraat.networks.utils

Class MaterialCompat

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.sefiraat.networks.utils.MaterialCompat

  • public final class MaterialCompat
extends java.lang.Object
    Version-safe Material helpers for APIs added after Minecraft 1.8.8.

    Many org.bukkit.Material constants used across the addon were introduced in 1.13+ (dyes, stained glass, terracotta, coral, vines, ...). Referencing them directly throws NoSuchFieldError at class-init on legacy servers. Resolving them through XMaterial instead yields the correct Material for the running version. XMaterial.parseMaterial() can still return null for a material with no legacy equivalent, so every entry point here substitutes a FALLBACK placeholder rather than passing null to a constructor.

      • isAir

        public static boolean isAir(@Nonnull
                            org.bukkit.Material material)
        Version-safe replacement for Material#isAir() (added in Minecraft 1.16). On older servers the method is absent, so air is detected by name instead.

      • isItem

        public static boolean isItem(@Nonnull
                             org.bukkit.Material material)
        Version-safe replacement for Material#isItem() (added in Minecraft 1.13). On older servers every non-air material can back an item, so that is the legacy assumption.

      • isFuel

        public static boolean isFuel(@Nonnull
                             org.bukkit.Material material)
        Version-safe replacement for Material#isFuel() (added in Minecraft 1.13). On older servers the method is absent and there is no reliable lookup, so false is returned - the calling code falls back to its non-fuel branch.

      • craftVanillaResult

        @Nullable
public static org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack craftVanillaResult(@Nonnull
                                                                          org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack[] matrix,
                                                                          @Nonnull
                                                                          org.bukkit.World world,
                                                                          @Nonnull
                                                                          org.bukkit.entity.Player player)
        Version-safe replacement for Bukkit#craftItem(ItemStack[], World, Player) (added in Minecraft 1.18), used to resolve vanilla crafting-grid recipes that Slimefun itself doesn't know about. On servers where the method doesn't exist (pre-1.18) this returns null instead of throwing, so callers should treat a null result as "no vanilla fallback available here" rather than "not a valid recipe".

      • craftingRecipe

        Version-safe replacement for Bukkit#getCraftingRecipe(ItemStack[], World) (added in Minecraft 1.18), used to resolve the vanilla recipe a blueprint encodes so the auto crafter can execute it. On servers where the method doesn't exist (pre-1.18) this returns null instead of throwing, so callers should treat a null result as "no vanilla recipe available here" rather than "not a valid recipe".
